style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted:
Looking for a cosy and charming piece to brighten up your home? The Lumineo LED House in White is just what you need! Perfect for creating a warm and inviting atmosphere, this enchanting piece is designed specifically for indoor use.

• Crafted from polyresin for an attractive design
• Dimensions: 20 cm x 18.5 cm x 21 cm, making it an ideal size for any room
• Features a steady warm white LED light for consistent and soothing illumination
• Operates with 3 AA batteries (not included), allowing for easy placement without power cords

This delightful LED house is perfect for adding a festive touch to your home.
